Name: Fertile Valley
Author: AD778
Description:
[b]WARNING:[/b] This mod uses harmony and chat-gpt generated code held together with duct tape, expect mod conflicts. It is classified as 2 separate mods but actually isn't, the 2 folders mutually depend on each other.
[b]
Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Purchase the mysterious [i]fertility pendant[/i], currently at Pierre's priced at a hefty 2g. Give to any eligible female NPC and find them knocked up the next morning[/*]
[*]Adds pregnancy sprites for all characters (only normal as of now)[/*]
[*]Tweaks pregnancy & birth logic to accommodate multiple pregnant NPCs and non-spouse pregnancies[/*]
[*]Removes the child cap as long as you are using the pendant, go wild[/*]
[/list][b]To-dos:[/b]
[list]
[*]Custom dialogues[/*]
[*]Dedicated pendant seller[/*]
[/list]
Compatible with 1.6 and above, requires SMAPI and Content Patcher
